title: feat(mermaid): create @floatboat/nexus-plugin-mermaid package
body:
## Summary

Create a standalone `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-mermaid` package that renders fenced `mermaid` code blocks as SVG diagrams. Follows the same `WidgetDefinition` API pattern as `plugin-math`.

OpenSpec: `openspec/changes/add-missing-features` (item 3.5 / Phase 3)

## Motivation

The mermaid rendering logic was previously hardcoded inside `packages/core/src/live-preview.ts`. Extracting it into a standalone plugin:
- Keeps with the existing plugin architecture (like `plugin-math` for KaTeX)
- Lets consumers opt in without pulling ~500KB mermaid.js by default
- Gives hosts control over mermaid config (theme, securityLevel, etc.)

## Changes

### New files
- `packages/plugin-mermaid/package.json` — Package config, deps: `nexus-core`, `mermaid ^11.0.0`, `@codemirror/view`
- `packages/plugin-mermaid/tsconfig.json` — Extends `tsconfig.base.json`
- `packages/plugin-mermaid/src/index.ts` — Core implementation (276 lines)
  - Lazy-load `mermaid.js` only when a mermaid block is first rendered
  - SVG cache keyed by source string avoids redundant re-renders
  - Hover-revealed ✎ edit button (mirrors `plugin-math` UX)
  - Parse-then-render flow: `mermaid.parse()` validates first (no error-bomb SVG in DOM)
  - Error display with "Edit source" link for invalid syntax
  - Orphan DOM cleanup in `destroy()` for mermaid-injected nodes
- `packages/plugin-mermaid/test/plugin-mermaid.test.ts` — 7 test cases

### Modified files
- `tsconfig.base.json` — Added `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-mermaid` path mapping
- `vitest.config.ts` — Added alias
- `package.json` — Added `nexus-plugin-mermaid` to build script
- `pnpm-lock.yaml` — Updated

## Test Plan

- ✅ 7 new tests pass (normal render, edit mode, non-mermaid blocks, async loading, error display, edit button, lifecycle cleanup)
- ✅ Full test suite: 522 tests pass, 0 regressions (35 test files)
- ✅ Build succeeds: `dist/index.js` (8.17 KB) + `dist/index.d.ts` (1017 B)

## Usage

```ts
import { createEditor } from "@floatboat/nexus-core";
import { createMermaidPlugin } from "@floatboat/nexus-plugin-mermaid";

const editor = createEditor({
  container: document.getElementById("editor")!,
  initialValue: "# Hello",
  plugins: [createMermaidPlugin()],
  livePreview: true,
});

feat(mermaid): create @floatboat/nexus-plugin-mermaid package

Extract mermaid diagram rendering into a standalone plugin package,
following the same WidgetDefinition pattern as plugin-math.

- Lazy-load mermaid.js (~500KB) only when a mermaid block is rendered
- SVG cache keyed by source string avoids redundant renders
- Hover-revealed edit button for entering edit mode (consistent with
  plugin-math)
- Error display with 'Edit source' link for invalid mermaid syntax
- Orphan DOM cleanup in destroy() for mermaid-injected nodes
- 7 test cases covering normal render, edit mode, non-mermaid blocks,
  async loading, syntax errors, and lifecycle cleanup

OpenSpec: openspec/changes/add-missing-features (item 3.5)
